contexts.text: See Lot (the man).
Because so long as they are in evil they cannot be in good. No one can serve two lords at the same time.
Thus shall ye say to my lord Esau () = the first acknowledgement of good, that it was in a higher place. Explained. AC 4245.
Good is called lord, and truth servant, before they have been conjoined.
Behold that lord of dreams cometh () = that they were vain things. Explained.
He was in the house of his lord the Egyptian () = that it might be initiated in natural good; (for) lord = good. AC 4973:2, Explained, Illustrated.
Good is called lord relatively to a servant, and father relatively to a son. Illustrated.
His lord saw that Jehovah was with him () = that it was perceived in natural good that the Divine was in it... (For) lord = good; here, natural good, because it is an Egyptian who is here the lord.
Behold my lord knoweth not what is with me in the house () = that natural good did not even wish for appropriation; (for) his lord = natural good.

Until his lord should come to his house () = in order that it might communicate with natural good; (for) lord = natural good not spiritual... He is called bis lord, because the Natural which is not spiritual considers the Spiritual as a servant.
To their lord the king of Egypt () = that they were against the new state of the natural man. Explained.

The man the lord of the land spake () = the Celestial of the Spiritual reigning in the Natural... Man is predicated of the Spiritual, and lord of the Celestial; for, in the internal sense, man = truth; and lord, good.
In Heaven... no one wants to be lord, and thus to regard another as a servant; but everyone wants to minister to and serve another. Illustrated.
(God hath set me) for a lord to everything of (Pharaoh's) house () = that from it is everything in the Natural... A lord, in the Word, is predicated of good.
If the lord of the woman () = truth conjoined with good. The lord = truth... because it here means a servant.
If his lord has given him a woman () = good adjoined to truth by the Spiritual when in combat: lord, here, = the Spiritual; for by lord here is meant one of the Sons of Israel... AC 8983.
I love my lord... ()... Lord = spiritual good a quo. AC 8990:4.
If she is evil in the eyes of her lord () = if the affection of truth from natural delight does not agree with spiritual truth... (for) lord = spiritual truth.

The lord, namely, of the woman, or a man, = truth... for a lord or man of a woman, in the Word = truth; and the woman, good; because by the marriage of a man with a woman is represented the marriage of truth and good.

The lord of the ox is guiltless () = no evil from the internal man, because from the Voluntary and not from the Intellectual... The lord of the ox = the internal or spiritual man; for by the ox is signified the affection of evil in the natural or external man... and the internal man is lord of the external. AC 9075. AC 9082.
The lord of the pit shall repay () = that he with whom is falsity shall make amends.

This division (of truth from good) is meant by the Lord's words in Luke: No one can serve two lords: either he will hate the one and love the other; or he will prefer the one and despise the other: ye cannot serve God and mammon (); that is, by faith to serve the Lord, and by love the world; thus to acknowledge truth, and do evil. He who does this has a divided mind. Hence his destruction.

The lord of the house shall be brought to God () = inquisition from good... The lord of the house = the good ex quo... because it is treating of truths and scientifics taken away out of the memory... and as these are of good, and in good, therefore the lord of the house = the good whose they are, and with whom they are. Good is called a lord, because truths and scientifics belong to good as to their lord.

The lord thereof shall take () = conjunction under good... The lord = good... because with the spiritual man good is in the first place... and that which is in the first place is here the lord. According to the quality of good also are all truths disposed with man, as a house by its lord. Hence it is that by the Lord, in the Word, is meant the Lord as to Divine good.
No one can serve two lords... Two lords = good and evil.
He shall repay to the lord thereof () = restitution (to the good of truth) for that (which has been taken away)... The lord = good.
The lord thereof not with it () = if the good of that truth is not together with it in the General. The lord = good.
If the lord is with it, he shall not repay () = if the good of truth is together with it, there shall be no restitution.

Let not anger wax hot, my lord () = that the Internal should not avert itself... Closes is here called by Aaron my lord, because the Internal is lord, and the External is relatively a servant. Explained.
Then the things of the internal man are closed, lest the man should serve two lords.
A dog Knows his master among a thousand...
A hard lord () = the evil of the love of self. ( = the evil of falsity. AE 654:49.)
Lords, and dominators = goods.
From which it may be evident that it is impossible to serve two lords.
Then the internal man is master and lord...
I said to him, Lord, thou knowest () = that the Lord alone has known this.
Because He is Lord of lords and King of kings () = because the Lord is good itself and truth itself.

Therefore the Third Heaven is called the Lord's dominion... and hence the Angels (there) are called sons of the Lord, thus also lords; and the Angels in the Second Heaven are called... kings. The former and latter Angels are meant by lords and kings, when the Lord is called Lord of lords and King of kings.
